extraction.title: Well Informed
extraction.subtitle: Is exercise as effective as treatments for depression and anxiety? Some big studies say yes. Many experts have reservations
extraction.summary: Recent studies suggest that exercise may be as effective as therapy or antidepressants in treating depression and anxiety, though experts caution about biases in the research. Aerobic activities are particularly beneficial, and the mechanisms behind these effects are still being explored.
